evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and updates RPC interface parameters and client parsing in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Solves an interface gap for testing and simulation tooling by adding multi-output coinbase support and optional mempool transaction inclusion to generateblock. The change is supported for pool and protocol simulation use cases, though reviewers have raised interface questions regarding remainder reward handling.
